<subject>Catherine Storey for NexusCorp Gas Transactions</subject>
<body>
I talked to each of you a couple of weeks ago, and this topic got pushed aside due to some other pressing issues.  However, each of you agreed that a standard cutoff time was acceptable for US gas, power and liquids advisory mandates.

The best option will be to agree to cutoff at 4pm each day (just to get an idea of the numbers we were talking about, I looked at yesterday to determine how many engagements were finalised after 4pm London time.  We had three US Gas matters, and two Canadian Gas matters).  After 4pm, the systems would automatically roll new NexusCorp engagements to the next day.  However, for those matters that do not roll after 4pm, the respective compliance and litigation teams would need to remember that these are the following day's business.  I am not sure how the procedures in Apex Advisory would need to be modified for the team's daily position summaries, as the official matter logs would not include these late submissions.  Can Apex Advisory run supplemental reports to ensure that the desks have accurate matter positions each morning?

I would appreciate any comments that you may have, and regardless, please re-confirm that a cutoff of 4pm works for each of your respective groups.

Danielle  
x36557

Eric - any potential problems with the DPR?  
Mary - we discussed briefly a few weeks back...any thoughts?
</body>
